$comment: GA4 event-scoped custom dimensions, one per event parameter the apps send.
GA4 COLLECTS unregistered parameters but cannot REPORT on them: until a
parameter is registered here it is invisible in explorations and audiences.
parameterName must match the event param in the code EXACTLY, and both it and
`scope` are immutable once created — only displayName/description can change.
GA4 allows 50 event-scoped custom dimensions per property.
Numeric params (duration_seconds, count) belong in custom METRICS, not here.

dimensions.description: First-touch source the visitor arrived with (?source / ?utm_source / ?ref), sent on sign_up. GA4's own attribution only understands utm_*, so a bare ?source=reddit visit looks organic to it — this parameter is the only way to attribute registrations to those campaigns. 'organic' when the visitor arrived with none. See client/src/scripts/analytics.ts (trackAuthSuccess).
Authentication provider on sign_up and login (currently always 'google'), and the join path on room_joined.
Whether a started call was created public (listed on the home) or private (link only). Sent on start_call.
Whether the person joining a room was already a signed-in account holder. Sent on room_joined.
Why a call could not start — room_full, banned, credits_exhausted. Sent on call_failed and limit_reached; the funnel drop-off is unreadable without it.
Which call-to-action was clicked on the marketing site. Sent on cta_clicked (website).
Where on the page the clicked call-to-action sits (hero, pricing, footer…). Sent on cta_clicked (website).
